headline: CoreWeave, a US AI cloud company, will open its first data centres in India, at an AdaniConneX campus near Mumbai.
score_reason: Pool score 6 kept: a company announcement; the investment size is Bloomberg's figure and the company gave none.
importance_line: It adds AI computing capacity for India's AI push, which CoreWeave links to the government's IndiaAI Mission, but the company gave no investment figure, Bloomberg's multi-billion figure is not confirmed by the company, and the first phase is not due until mid-2028.
summary: CoreWeave, a US company that rents computing power to AI firms, announced on Wednesday that it will open its first data centres in India, with 240 megawatts at AdaniConneX's Navi Mumbai campus. Bloomberg reports that the investment will total multiple billions of dollars over the life of the project, and CoreWeave expects the first phase to come online in mid-2028.
